meaning: With upstream's own option -DautoImplicit=false, from a fresh scratch directory (nothing carried over), all 38 files of the Lieb-Thirring closure compile under Lean v4.34.0-rc2 with LeanMaster's Mathlib (rev 85e3a25e) after the single declared rename Set.equivOfEq -> Equiv.setCongr, and #print axioms OAI.SharpLiebThirring.sharp_lieb_thirring lists exactly propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. This closes the autoImplicit gap the verifier of LT_D2 found.
does_not_establish: compilation under upstream's pinned toolchain (Lean 4.34.1, Mathlib d13f23b7): this toolchain differs (Lean 4.34.0-rc2, Mathlib 85e3a25e)
that the formalised statement adequately formalises the Lieb-Thirring conjecture (no human statement audit; an adversarial model reading found no vacuity)
